Sharks, eels, salmon, pupfish. So many fish end up in such weird places and against all odds survive. In some cases these accidents create whole new species. But how do saltwater fish, like bull sharks, adapt to freshwater. And what kinds of lakes or rivers are you most likely to see a shark?
